description:
Delete a time block. Its ref is pruned from the day's timeline_order; for a task bucket, the tasks themselves are untouched (they fall back to the day's computed bucket).

On a recurring block, this removes it from THAT DAY ONLY (the app's "Remove from today"): the block keeps coming back on the other days, and the skipped day does not break the habit streak. To stop the repetition itself, use stop_recurring_block.
name: delete_day_block
